baseline.name: Median price
baseline.blurb: Predicts the median training price for every house. Anything useful has to beat it.

ols.name: Linear regression
ols.blurb: Ordinary least squares on log price. No tuning, no regularisation.

enet.name: Elastic net
enet.blurb: Linear regression with L1 + L2 penalties that shrink and drop weak features.

tree.name: Decision tree
tree.blurb: One tree of yes/no splits. Easy to read, prone to memorising the data.

rf.name: Random forest
rf.blurb: 300 deep trees on bootstrap samples, averaged.

xgb.name: XGBoost
xgb.blurb: Gradient-boosted shallow trees, each one correcting the errors of the ones before.

mlp.name: Neural network
mlp.blurb: A small multilayer perceptron (one or two hidden layers, at most 128 units).

stack.name: Stacked ensemble
stack.blurb: Feeds out-of-fold predictions from the tuned elastic net, random forest, XGBoost and neural network into a linear blender with non-negative weights.
